zlib framing (RFC 1950) ported from Go compress/zlib semantics.

Thin wrapper over our own flate (RFC 1951): 2-byte header, raw DEFLATE body, 4-byte big-endian Adler-32 trailer. Works on Input/Output: header/trailer parsed from borrowed spans (zero-copy), body inflated straight into the caller's reusable buffer.
